en.headline: Fong Kai-shen takes Asian Games men’s épée bronze
en.dek: The Hong Kong fencer reached the semi-finals before losing 13-15 to a Kazakh opponent, securing the medal as the event has no bronze-medal bout.
body: Hong Kong’s Fong Kai-shen claimed bronze in the men’s individual épée at the Asian Games in Nagoya on Thursday after reaching the semi-finals.

In the last eight he defeated South Korea’s Jang Hyo-min 13-12 in a deciding touch, having trailed for much of the bout before levelling and then winning the final point. In the semi-final he lost 13-15 to a Kazakh fencer after recovering from 3-6 and 9-9 deficits before falling short in the closing stages.
Because the competition does not stage a bronze-medal match, Fong’s semi-final appearance guaranteed Hong Kong the medal. Teammate Ng Ho-tin exited in the other quarter-final.

zh.headline: 方凱申亞運男子重劍個人賽奪銅
zh.dek: 港隊劍手方凱申晉身四強後不敵哈薩克對手，由於賽事不設銅牌賽，穩奪一面獎牌。
body: 名古屋亞運男子重劍個人賽，港隊代表方凱申在準決賽不敵哈薩克劍手，最終以13比15落敗，為港隊增添一面銅牌。
方凱申較早在八強以13比12擊敗韓國劍手張孝敏晉級，該場大部分時間落後，尾段追成平手後以「決一劍」勝出。準決賽他一度落後3比6及追平9比9，其後再落後12比14，最後一劍雙方同時得分仍以13比15告負。
由於賽事不設銅牌賽，方凱申晉身四強已肯定為香港奪得獎牌。另一名港隊代表吳浩天在另一場八強止步。
